auth_detail: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>. OAuth scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/presentations (or .../auth/drive). Access token obtained externally (Google OAuth 2.0 / service account); plugin consumes the access token directly.

endpoints.note: Validates the OAuth access token (different host: oauth2 tokeninfo). Returns the token's scopes/expiry; used only to confirm the token is live before real Slides calls.

batch_update_requests.purpose: insert a shape on a page
add a table of given rows/cols
remove a page element or slide
embed a linked Google Sheets chart

notes: batchUpdate is the single write endpoint — almost every write operation (create slide/shape/table/image, insert text, replace text, delete, transform) is a request object inside one requests[] array. This is a strong fit for the modular payload contract: many unit/aggregator builders feed one batchUpdate write component.
create_presentation accepts only a title; other body fields are ignored.
Auth is OAuth bearer access token (no static API key). User supplies the access token at the Token input.
